properties.description: Nine real-binary tests with an isolated HOME and TMPDIR. They cover: every served tool through `read` (reads run, and each also runs through plain --call; nothing but bookkeeping moves; every other tool is refused before anything is opened, leaving the folder byte-identical); `read` creating nothing where there is no design; export_graph and export_surface with a path refused through `read` and written through `write`; `write` running a write and a read, with JSON positional, as --args and from stdin; `--read-only write` refused; the listing; quiet logs; every --help flag typed after `read`; and --graph-path after the verb.
properties.name: a_terminal_agent_auto_approves_reads_and_confirms_each_write.rs
